connectors.use_case: Finding out what went down during last night's outage, pausing a monitor during planned maintenance, posting a status page update while an incident is being worked.

connectors.name: Smart Grow Logs
connectors.description: Lists error groups, reads issue details with sample stack traces and returns issue statistics from a logging and error-tracking service, read-only.
connectors.use_case: Finding the most frequent production errors this week, reading the stack trace behind a spike.

connectors.name: SNA Displays
connectors.description: Reads SNA Displays LED video wall health, diagnostics, history, alerts, faults, network status, daily reports, service cases and RMAs, views monitoring-camera captures and requests wall status refreshes.
connectors.use_case: Checking overnight alerts on a stadium scoreboard, viewing a camera capture of a lobby wall after a fault, following up an open RMA.

connectors.name: SolidPing
connectors.description: Creates, runs and diagnoses uptime and synthetic monitoring checks across many check types, reads results and incidents, and manages status pages, incident updates and maintenance windows.
connectors.use_case: Setting up an SSL-expiry check for a domain, finding out why an API check failed overnight, posting an incident update to a status page.

connectors.name: Spot Downtime
connectors.description: Lists website, API, server and cron monitors with live status, response times and incidents, creates, updates, pauses and deletes monitors, posts incident updates and schedules maintenance windows.
connectors.use_case: Checking whether anything is down right now, putting the API into maintenance during a deploy, adding a one-minute check on a new landing page.

connectors.name: Stackpulse
connectors.description: Tracks vendor status pages and URL monitors on Stackpulse dashboards, reporting current stack status, incident history, outages and vendor reliability, and creates or renames dashboards, adds or removes services, adds monitors and runs, pauses or resumes checks.
connectors.use_case: Checking whether a 3 pm API slowdown came from a vendor outage, ranking vendors by downtime this quarter.

connectors.name: Status Is Down
connectors.description: Returns current status, outage report history, geographic report distribution, problem indicators and report spikes for monitored online services.
connectors.use_case: Checking whether a payment provider is down right now, reviewing a service's recent outage history, seeing which regions report problems.

connectors.name: Steadybit
connectors.description: Find reliability risks in your systems: design, run, and analyze chaos experiments.
connectors.use_case: Designing a chaos experiment for a checkout service before Black Friday, analyzing the results for a new failure mode.

connectors.name: Stealthium
connectors.description: One control plane for GPU health, network, operations, & security: Across every chip, every cloud, every region.
connectors.use_case: Checking which GPU cluster is overheating in one region, comparing network latency across two clouds.

connectors.name: Store Canary
connectors.description: Checks whether a WooCommerce store is working by reporting reachability, HTTPS and redirect behavior, WooCommerce detection, whether cart and checkout pages load and which payment methods are visible, without placing orders or changing the store.
connectors.use_case: Confirming a client's checkout still loads after a plugin update, checking which payment methods a shop shows, verifying a store redirects to HTTPS.

connectors.name: Subtext
connectors.description: Session replay built for agents, opening production sessions to inspect screenshots, accessibility trees, DOM diffs, and console and network activity, with masking and DLP tools.
connectors.use_case: Investigating the session linked from a bug report, diffing DOM state around the moment a form failed, reading the console errors that preceded a crash.

connectors.name: Sumo Logic
connectors.description: Runs Sumo Logic log searches, searches and reads alerts, investigates and updates security insights, lists fields, partitions and extraction rules, and creates, reads and updates dashboards.
connectors.use_case: Searching last hour's 500 errors from the checkout service, reassigning a security insight, adding a latency panel to a dashboard.

connectors.name: Suntropy Connect Monitoring
connectors.description: Connects solar inverter platforms such as Huawei FusionSolar, Sungrow and Fronius to Suntropy, reads plant status, energy, power curves, device history, alarms and production health, and marks alarms read or pauses their automatic AI reviews.
connectors.use_case: Checking which of 40 client plants produced below forecast yesterday, pausing AI reviews of a recurring alarm on a Growatt inverter.

connectors.name: Svitgrid
connectors.description: Reads Svitgrid home solar station data, including power, battery, energy totals, grid rates, inverter mode, device health, forecasts and history, diagnoses stations and reads fleet analytics.
connectors.use_case: Checking why the battery did not charge overnight, comparing this month's solar output with last month.

connectors.name: SYSCNC - Systems4you
connectors.description: Reports CNC machine status, run and idle time, stoppages and their reasons, parts produced, alarms and work orders from SYSCNC, and records stop reasons on a stoppage.
connectors.use_case: Checking why a lathe stopped during the night shift, counting parts produced per machine this week, assigning a reason to an unexplained stop.

connectors.name: TaskBeacon
connectors.description: Lists TaskBeacon scheduled jobs and runs, reports missed runs and recent problems, creates jobs, returns setup code, pauses and resumes jobs, updates schedules and suggests timing.
connectors.use_case: Finding which nightly R scripts failed last night, adding monitoring to a PowerShell export job.

connectors.name: Telecom District
connectors.description: Reads Telecom District Kontrol Edge network services, including ports, cloud connections, internet, DC interconnect, backbone, firewall and SD-WAN services with throughput, latency and CRC errors, BGP sessions and routes, plus alarms, incidents, outages and planned maintenance.
connectors.use_case: Checking which cloud connections are down, reviewing BGP sessions on backbone services, confirming whether an incident hit any services this week.

connectors.name: Telemetry Machine
connectors.description: Runs Telemetry Machine queries over traces, logs and metrics, reads schemas and field values, creates datasets and ingest keys and edits dashboards, widgets, saved views, SLOs and annotations.
connectors.use_case: Investigating a spike in checkout errors, adding an SLO for API latency.

connectors.name: telemetry.dev
connectors.description: Searches telemetry.dev traces and sessions of AI applications, reads span payloads, logs, findings and usage summaries.
connectors.use_case: Finding why a support agent's runs got slow yesterday, checking token cost by project.

connectors.name: Traversal
connectors.description: Starts AI investigations of production incidents across logs, metrics, traces, alerts and changes, follows up on them, and reads past investigations, runbooks and agent activity in Traversal.
connectors.use_case: Investigating why checkout-service has returned 500 errors since 14:00, reviewing last week's database incident report.

connectors.name: Trazio: Observability, Security and Robot Telemetry
connectors.description: Reads Trazio telemetry pipelines for logs, metrics, traces, security events, robot data and video, searching events, investigating incidents, tracing runs and correlations, and opening video timelines and exports.
connectors.use_case: Investigating why a warehouse robot faulted at 3 a.m., listing open security incidents from the past 24 hours, checking why an Argo CD deployment sync failed.

connectors.name: Tsuga
connectors.description: Query telemetry and manage assets.
connectors.use_case: Investigating production incidents, searching logs and traces, monitoring infrastructure assets.

connectors.name: TunnelHQ
connectors.description: Monitors VPN servers over protocols such as WireGuard, OpenVPN, IKEv2 and Shadowsocks, plus websites, APIs, ports, DNS and scheduled jobs, showing which monitors are down and why, reading results, latency and incidents, acknowledging and retesting incidents, running on-demand VPN tests, and creating and updating tunnels, Uptime checks, heartbeats and subscriptions, with no delete access.
connectors.use_case: Finding out why a WireGuard server failed its Verify step overnight, testing a batch of VPN servers after a config change, adding an Uptime check for a new API endpoint.

connectors.name: turbometrics
connectors.description: Reads website performance scans, score history, findings and alerts from a turbometrics account, compares two domains, triggers new scans, and reports real user Core Web Vitals with daily trends and slowest pages.
connectors.use_case: Finding what dragged down a homepage's latest score, comparing a site with a competitor's, checking INP trends after a JavaScript release.

connectors.name: UptimeEye
connectors.description: Creates and manages UptimeEye HTTP, TCP, ping and DNS monitors, cron heartbeats, notification channels, log alerts, incidents and status pages, and reads check results and uptime statistics.
connectors.use_case: Adding a heartbeat for a nightly 2 am database backup, opening an incident on the public status page.

connectors.name: Uptimeify
connectors.description: Runs live website, SSL, DNS, email-authentication, blacklist, WHOIS and port checks, and manages monitors, incidents, status pages, maintenance windows, notification channels, customers and reports in a white-label monitoring account.
connectors.use_case: Investigating an outage and posting an incident update to a client's status page, checking DMARC and SPF for a new domain, scheduling a maintenance window.

connectors.name: Uptimely
connectors.description: Reads Uptimely monitors, status history, incidents, alerts, maintenance windows, on-call schedules and status pages, and with AI writes enabled creates monitors, runs probes and declares incidents.
connectors.use_case: Checking which monitors failed overnight and who is on call, declaring an incident and saving a postmortem after an outage.

connectors.name: UptimeRobot
connectors.description: Creates HTTP, keyword, ping, port, heartbeat, DNS, API, and UDP monitors in UptimeRobot, triages incidents, schedules maintenance windows, and publishes status pages.
connectors.use_case: Adding a monitor for a new API endpoint, checking what caused an overnight alert, scheduling a maintenance window before a deploy.

connectors.name: Uptimy
connectors.description: Reads Uptimy monitors, uptime and latency by region, incidents and reports, and adds monitors, alerts, status pages and maintenance windows, posts incident updates and triggers checks.
connectors.use_case: Checking whether last month's API uptime met a 99.9 percent SLA, posting an update on tonight's checkout outage.

connectors.name: Uptrack
connectors.description: Checks any public URL on demand, lists monitors with status, uptime and response-time analytics, shows dashboard stats and incidents, acknowledges incidents, creates, updates, pauses, resumes and deletes monitors, and creates alert channels.
connectors.use_case: Checking whether a checkout page is reachable right now, pausing a monitor during maintenance, acknowledging an ongoing incident.

connectors.name: Version Info
connectors.description: Lists Version Info environments and their inventory of Linux packages, kernels, PHP, Node.js and Python versions or WordPress core, plugins and themes, shows recent changes, renames environments and gives setup and disconnect links.
connectors.use_case: Finding which servers still run PHP 8.1, checking which WordPress plugins changed on a client site this week.

connectors.name: Vibesmonitor
connectors.description: Reads errors, feedback, uptime, consent and cookie data across Vibesmonitor projects, creates projects, configures uptime endpoints, feedback widgets and cookie banners, and edits a project canvas.
connectors.use_case: Checking which of five side projects threw new errors today, setting up an uptime check for a new API endpoint.

connectors.name: Victron
connectors.description: Lists and searches Victron Energy installations, reads live status, energy statistics, data and alarm logs and DESS schedules, exports data, adds sites and clears alarms.
connectors.use_case: Checking battery state of charge on an off-grid cabin system, exporting last month's solar yield.

connectors.name: Vigil by PuzariCloud
connectors.description: Reads Vigil monitors, servers, incidents, errors, traces, logs and slow queries, shows incident timelines and acknowledges incidents.
connectors.use_case: Checking what is down right now and which database queries are slowest on a server this morning.

connectors.name: Vigilia
connectors.description: Monitors live web apps for errors, failed requests and downtime, lists open incidents with plain-language diagnoses, evidence and fix prompts, reports app health and install status, and marks incidents fixed for confirmation against real traffic.
connectors.use_case: Listing the worst open incidents on a Lovable app, reading the fix prompt for a failing checkout request, marking an incident fixed after deploying.

connectors.name: Visual Sentinel
connectors.description: Monitors websites for uptime, SSL, DNS, domain expiry, speed and visual changes against a baseline, acknowledges and resolves alerts and incidents, creates and configures monitors, alert rules, channels, maintenance windows, status pages and server monitors, and runs one-off website, SSL, DNS and Lighthouse checks.
connectors.use_case: Checking what is down right now and acknowledging the alert, scheduling a maintenance window for a weekend deploy, running an SSL check on a new subdomain.

connectors.name: Visualping
connectors.description: Creates, updates, runs and deletes Visualping page monitors, sets schedules, alerts and actions, and reads, flags and hides detected changes.
connectors.use_case: Watching a competitor's pricing page daily, alerting only when the Pro plan price changes.

connectors.name: Watchgoose
connectors.description: Inspects Watchgoose checks and status history for cron jobs, backups and Kubernetes jobs, and with write consent creates, updates, pauses or deletes checks.
connectors.use_case: Confirming last night's backup job actually ran, finding which check has failed most this month, pausing an alert during a maintenance window.

connectors.name: Watchman Tower
connectors.description: Reports website, server, SSL certificate and domain monitoring status, incidents, response times, expirations and server resource usage, and creates, pauses, resumes and deletes monitors.
connectors.use_case: Finding certificates that expire this month, checking disk usage on a server, pausing a monitor during maintenance.

connectors.name: Zovo Website Status Checker
connectors.description: Checks whether up to 10 websites are up from the edge, following redirects, reporting HTTP status, timing, HTTPS and security header grades, robots.txt and sitemap.
connectors.use_case: Checking whether a client site is down after a DNS change, grading its security headers.
